name: xjb-coding
description: Agent Skills for coding workflows, multi-user multi-agent collaboration via the xjb_code backend, real-browser Web debugging (ego-browser first on macOS), Web prototypes, Blender + Three.js, and local ComfyUI workflows. One skill set shared by Codex, Claude Code, and Hermes.

interface.shortDescription: Self-driving coding, multi-agent collaboration, browser debugging, Web / 3D / ComfyUI workflows.
interface.longDescription: xjb_coding packages the workflow Skills a coding agent needs end to end: refine requirements, split tasks, code with TDD behind four quality gates, checkpoint and resume across sessions, and coordinate several agents through the optional xjb_code backend (per-user API keys, shared task board, human approvals). It also covers real-browser Web debugging that prefers the official ego-browser (ego lite) skill on macOS, sketch-to-prototype Web UX, Blender + Three.js assets, and editable local ComfyUI workflows with official references and local extensions. Comfy CLI/MCP and ego lite are external tools; missing tools produce setup instructions. Source and docs: https://github.com/0xdevelop/xjb_coding
